title: A semiclassical approach to spectral estimates for random Landau Schrodinger operators
summary: We prove spectral properties for random Landau Schrödinger operators on $L^2(\mathbb{R}^2)$ with bounded, random potentials supported in a square $Λ_L \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ of side length $L>0$, using semiclassical pseudodifferential calculus. The semiclassical parameter $h$ is the inverse of the magnetic field strength $B > 0$. By means of the Grushin method, we are led to the analysis of an effective Hamiltonian on $L^2 (\mathbb{R})$, the principal term of which is a sum of certain compact, self-adjoint pseudodifferential operators.
